semantics.minimum_claim_role: minimum_claim_authority under the externally anchored roster and quorum; an active successor must be equal or broader than the prior active floor, with supported scenario IDs exact under comparator v0.1
semantics.minimum_protocol_and_activation_roles: claim_authority AND optical_expert_authority AND manufacturing_statistics_authority AND machine_execution_authority
semantics.within_role: the human-owned roster selects exactly AND or OR per required role; AND requires every listed allowlisted signer and OR requires exactly a positive one-signature minimum, with no zero-quorum mode
semantics.final_go: final_go_authority after independently recomputed A-E and complete post-evidence release; only signed GO completes, while NO_GO/STOP/CANCEL/SUPERSEDE never become GO
semantics.expert_label_dimensions: expert_worth_reviewing AND expert_production_usable; authorized rater count, blinding, combination, duplicate-cluster aggregation, and independence rule are human-owned

minimum_claim_authority.purpose: human approval of the immutable north-star minimum claim floor and only equal-or-broader successors; not protocol execution or final GO

claim_authority.purpose: claim wording, supported scope, exclusions, and claim-envelope disposition; not final GO

optical_expert_authority.purpose: optical rubric, non-waivable endpoints, TOR interpretation, expert-label dimensions, and duplicate-cluster semantics

manufacturing_statistics_authority.purpose: sampling, independence, ITT, confidence, TOR, manufacturing metrics, productivity analysis, and statistical disposition

machine_execution_authority.purpose: machine host, entry inventory, OS admission boundary, lease, launch ticket, toolchain pins, and receipt policy

final_go_authority.purpose: post-evidence GO, NO_GO, STOP, CANCEL, or SUPERSEDE after A-E and final-release evidence; only GO completes the Goal
